text: As you start to walk on the way, the way appears.
author: Jalāl al-Dīn Muḥammad Rūmī

text: Have patience. All things are difficult before they become easy.
author: Saadi Shirazi

text: Concentrate every minute on doing what is in front of you with precise and genuine seriousness.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: I wish I could show you, when you are lonely or in darkness, the astonishing light of your own being.
author: Hafez

text: The knowledge of anything, since all things have causes, is not acquired or complete unless it is known by its causes.
author: Ibn Sina (Avicenna)

text: It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
author: Seneca

text: May wisdom be your guide and keep your heart from every sorrow.
author: Ferdowsi
